subject.title: fix: stop blocked tool loops stalling until timeout

question: Should this availability fix land together with the test-router/UI/Codex shard repairs after the contributor supplies a redacted real agent-runtime breaker trace?
rationale: The loop repair is focused, but the branch intentionally bundles separate test-infrastructure fixes and the repository’s protected maintainer label requires an explicit maintainer decision on that scope.

options.title: Land together after runtime proof
options.body: Accept the bundled validation repairs if a redacted live agent trace demonstrates the global-breaker path and the maintainer agrees the CI fixes belong in the same change.

options.title: Split validation repairs
options.body: Keep the loop-detector repair focused and move the isolated-UI/Codex test-routing changes to a separate PR if maintainers prefer narrower ownership and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Land together after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled validation repairs if a redacted live agent trace demonstrates the global-breaker path and the maintainer agrees the CI fixes belong in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current repair and its accompanying validation-routing changes, so they are best positioned to provide the requested live proof and clarify why the bundled CI work belongs here.
